title: Code and derived data for: Mapping Climate-Technology Vulnerability across Morocco: An Open-Data Provincial Index, Spatial Typologies, and Urban-Rural Inequalities
description: R pipeline, pinned administrative boundaries, derived ADM2 indicator and result tables, logs, supplementary tables and figure code for an open-data Climate-Technology Vulnerability Index (CTVI) covering Morocco's 75 provinces and prefectures. Raw inputs (NASA POWER, WorldPop, OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik) are downloaded by the scripts. Funded by the British Council Going Global Partnerships - Research Environments programme (grant RE2025-942).
